name: unbearable heartbreak
source:
unbearable heartbreak have you following the brooding journey of Soli, remembering his first and only crush as he travels back to the land that brought him hope, love, joy and then crushed it all...

[From [url=https://okenki.itch.io/unbearable-heartbreak]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
令人难以忍受的心碎让你跟随索利的沉思之旅，回忆起他第一次也是唯一一次迷恋，因为他回到了这片给他带来希望、爱和欢乐的土地，然后又粉碎了这一切……

[来自[url=https://okenki.itch.io/unbearable-heartbreak]itch.io[/url]]
